rejected.why: Negative for hepatocyte paraffin 1, arginase 1, and glypican-3 argues against hepatocellular carcinoma.
Smooth muscle actin positivity alone is nonspecific and less supported than melanoma markers.
Fatty infiltration is an incidental finding and does not explain the enhancing lesion or immunostaining profile.
